articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in late April 2026, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between LLM performance and expert human specialists in several domains.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's latest Gemini Ultra 2 model set new records on SWE-Bench and WebArena agentic benchmarks, demonstrating an ability to autonomously complete multi-hour software engineering and web research tasks with minimal human intervention. The model leverages a new architecture combining mixture-of-experts with persistent memory modules, enabling coherent task execution over extended sessions.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the first large-scale commercial deployment of its Figure 03 humanoid robot at BMW's Spartanburg, SC manufacturing plant, with over 200 units performing parts logistics, inspection, and light assembly tasks. The robots operate alongside human workers using on-board vision-language models for real-time task adaptation, marking a milestone in general-purpose humanoid deployment at industrial scale.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' fully electric Atlas robot completed a DARPA-organized urban disaster response trial in which it autonomously navigated collapsed structures, manipulated valves and doors, and carried a 40-pound rescue payload across uneven terrain. The trial showcased new whole-body predictive control algorithms that allow Atlas to recover from unexpected perturbations without pre-mapped environments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's 'Artifacts OS' — A Full In-Context Development Environment
articles.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's Artifacts feature into a full in-context operating environment that lets users build, preview, and deploy web applications, data pipelines, and interactive visualizations entirely within a chat session. The system integrates persistent file storage, package management, and CI/CD-like deployment to Anthropic's hosted infrastructure, blurring the line between AI assistant and cloud IDE.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production on A14 2nm Process with GAA Transistors
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production of its N2 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors at its Kaohsiung fab, with Apple and NVIDIA as lead customers. The node delivers a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N3E, enabling the next generation of AI accelerator chips expected to ship in consumer and data center products by late 2026.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Scale
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing reliable execution of complex quantum circuits using 32 error-corrected logical qubits on Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion system, achieving logical error rates below 10⁻⁶. This represents a roughly 100x improvement over prior demonstrations and establishes a credible roadmap toward quantum advantage in materials simulation and combinatorial optimization within two to three years.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink announced FDA clearance for its N2 implant, a second-generation BCI device featuring 4,096 electrode channels — quadruple the original — with wireless charging and bidirectional stimulation capabilities. Early clinical trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks, and the bidirectional design opens pathways for somatosensory feedback in future prosthetic applications.
